policies.title: Approved specification exists before implementation

source.text: Production implementation MUST NOT begin without an approved specification.

policies.title: Requirements are testable and traceable

source.text: Requirements MUST be testable and traceable.

policies.title: Functional and non-functional requirements stay distinguishable

source.text: Functional and non-functional requirements MUST remain distinguishable.

policies.title: Ambiguities resolved or recorded as explicit assumptions

source.text: Ambiguities MUST be resolved or recorded as explicit assumptions.

policies.title: Material upstream changes trigger downstream impact analysis

source.text: Material upstream changes MUST trigger downstream impact analysis.

policies.title: Code changes map to requirements

source.text: Existing code MUST NOT become an undocumented substitute for the specification.

policies.title: Explicit dependency graph or state model in use

source.text: It MUST use an explicit dependency graph or equivalent stateful model.

policies.title: Every stage defines inputs, outputs, criteria, ownership, failure behavior

source.text: Every stage MUST define inputs, outputs, entry criteria, exit criteria, ownership, and failure behavior.

policies.title: State, context, provenance, and decision lineage preserved

source.text: Workflow state, cross-stage context, artifact provenance, and decision lineage MUST be preserved.

policies.title: Agent autonomy is bounded, observable, and auditable

source.text: Agent autonomy MUST be bounded, observable, and auditable.

policies.title: High-impact actions have explicit human approval

source.text: High-impact actions MUST require explicit human approval.

policies.title: Approval, rejection, escalation, timeout, and safe-stop behavior defined

source.text: Approval, rejection, escalation, timeout, and safe-stop behavior MUST be defined.

policies.title: Mandatory approval gates are not skipped

source.text: Mandatory approval gates MUST NOT be silently skipped.

policies.title: Lack of response is never approval

source.text: Lack of response MUST NOT be interpreted as approval.

policies.title: Red-green-refactor evidence for domain and orchestration behavior

source.text: An initially failing test MUST be written before the corresponding implementation.

policies.title: Required test categories present

source.text: The test suite MUST include unit, integration, API contract, orchestration transition, reliability, security, and end-to-end tests.

policies.title: Completion requires executed validation

source.text: Task completion MUST require executed validation, not merely generated code.

policies.title: Input validation and URL scheme restriction verified

source.text: External input MUST be validated and normalized. Acceptable URL schemes MUST be restricted.

policies.title: No secrets or sensitive information in logs and evidence

source.text: Secrets and sensitive information MUST NOT be exposed in logs.

policies.title: Secure configuration defaults

source.text: Secure configuration defaults MUST be applied.

policies.title: Security documentation present

source.text: Authentication assumptions, rate limiting, threat scenarios, and security trade-offs MUST be documented.

policies.title: Dependency and secret scanning executed with no unresolved high or critical finding

source.text: Dependency scanning and secret scanning MUST be included in release readiness.

policies.advisory_note: DEC-054: an unresolved high or critical finding (neither remediated nor covered by a human-approved exception) fails this policy and blocks release readiness.

policies.title: Policy version recorded for the run

source.text: Every orchestration run MUST identify the policy version evaluated.

policies.title: Every applicable check has exactly one outcome

source.text: Every applicable policy check MUST produce exactly one outcome: PASS, FAIL, EXCEPTION-REQUESTED, or NOT-APPLICABLE.

policies.title: A failed mandatory check blocks downstream progression

source.text: A failed mandatory policy check MUST block downstream workflow progression.

policies.title: Exceptions are human-approved and complete

source.text: A policy exception MUST require explicit human approval and MUST record: applicable policy, reason, scope, approving authority, compensating control, approval timestamp, and expiry or review condition.

policies.title: Changes to approved items pass impact analysis and change approval

source.text: Changes to approved requirements, architecture, schemas, workflow states, security controls, or release criteria MUST pass formal impact analysis and change approval.

policies.title: Release readiness fails on a violated mandatory policy or unapproved exception

source.text: Release readiness MUST fail if a mandatory compliance or change-control policy remains violated or has an unapproved exception.

policies.title: Policy outcomes and exceptions appear in audit and traceability evidence

source.text: Policy outcomes and exceptions MUST be included in audit and traceability evidence.

policies.title: Only approved dependencies are used

source.text: Versioned policy guardrails MUST be defined covering security, compliance, privacy, audit retention, approved dependencies, software licensing, and change control.

policies.title: Dependency licenses are on the approved list

source.text: Versioned policy guardrails MUST be defined covering security, compliance, privacy, audit retention, approved dependencies, software licensing, and change control.

policies.title: No personal data stored beyond the approved analytics and client-identifier fields

source.text: Versioned policy guardrails MUST be defined covering security, compliance, privacy, audit retention, approved dependencies, software licensing, and change control.

policies.title: Audit records are retained and not purged; analytics purge follows retention

source.text: Versioned policy guardrails MUST be defined covering security, compliance, privacy, audit retention, approved dependencies, software licensing, and change control.

policies.title: Concerns are separated behind explicit interfaces

source.text: Domain logic, API delivery, persistence, orchestration, policy enforcement, telemetry, and infrastructure concerns MUST be separated.

policies.title: Material architectural decisions and rejected alternatives recorded

source.text: Material architectural decisions and rejected alternatives MUST be recorded.

policies.title: Failures classified; retries bounded

source.text: Transient and permanent failures MUST be classified. Bounded retries MUST be used where appropriate, with defined backoff and timeout behavior.

policies.title: Idempotency, fallback, rollback versus compensation, safe-stop, and resumption defined and tested

source.text: Repeatable operations MUST be idempotent. Rollback and compensation MUST be distinguished. Controlled resumption after interruption MUST be supported.

policies.title: Evidence of success, failure, retry, compensation, recovery, and latency captured

source.text: Evidence of success, failure, retry, compensation, recovery, and latency MUST be captured.

policies.title: Every run has a correlation or run identifier

source.text: Each orchestration execution MUST be assigned a correlation or run identifier.

policies.title: Transitions, decisions, approvals, retries, failures, replans, and outcomes recorded

source.text: State transitions, decisions, approvals, retries, failures, replanning events, and terminal outcomes MUST be recorded.

policies.title: Audit evidence has all required fields

source.text: Audit evidence MUST include actor type, action, timestamp, affected artifact or state, result, and reason.

policies.title: Demonstration metrics distinguished from production measurements

source.text: Demonstration metrics MUST be clearly distinguished from production measurements.

policies.title: Traceability chain complete, gaps shown

source.text: Traceability MUST be maintained across requirement, scenario, decision, design, task, implementation, test, validation, documentation, and evidence.

policies.title: No fabricated approval, test, execution, or operational evidence

source.text: Approval, test, execution, and operational evidence MUST NOT be fabricated.

policies.title: AI-generated artifacts reviewed and owned by a human

source.text: AI-generated artifacts MUST receive human review and ownership.

policies.title: Documentation evolves with implementation

source.text: Documentation MUST evolve with implementation.

policies.title: Commits are small, coherent, and describe engineering intent

source.text: Commits MUST be small and logically coherent; messages MUST describe engineering intent.

policies.title: Completion criteria 1 to 10 satisfied

source.text: A feature or task is complete only when all of the following hold.

policies.title: Plan includes a Constitution Check

source.text: /speckit-plan MUST include a Constitution Check mapping the plan to each principle I-XI.

policies.title: Release readiness is declared only by the human candidate

source.text: Release readiness MUST be declared only by the human candidate, based on reviewable evidence.

policies.title: Commit-message length and style hints

source.text: Commit messages describe engineering intent (style guidance only).

policies.advisory_note: Advisory: reported, never blocks. The mandatory commit policy is POL-TRC-005.
